tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find Saudi government tenders (Etimad) about a subject, product or service, whether open or closed. Takes a keyword (Arabic keywords match more) with optional activity, region and open-only filters. Returns up to 20 tenders, each with its agency, dates, status and pag

tools.name: get_tender
tools.description: Use this when you have an Etimad reference number and need that one tender: agency, activity, deadlines, booklet price, winners and awarded values, the Etimad link and the page url. Takes the reference number as written. Not for finding tenders by subject. تفاصيل منافسةٍ واحدة برقمها المرجعي: الجهة

tools.name: agency_summary
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about a Saudi government entity's tendering: how many tenders it issued, what is open now, what it buys most and which companies win its contracts. Takes the entity name in Arabic or English, or its id. Returns counts, top activities and top winning companies with page ur

tools.name: company_summary
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about a company's record in Saudi government tenders: how often it bid and won, the value it won, which entities it wins from, its activities and recent wins. Takes the company name in Arabic or English, or its id. For a company listed on Tadawul, `listed.url` is its Daal

tools.name: market_report
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about the Saudi government tender market in one month: how many tenders were issued and awarded, their value, the change on the month before, and the most active entities and activities. Takes the month as YYYY-MM. The stage is in_progress, preliminary or final. Not for a

tools.name: open_tenders
tools.description: Use this when the user wants tenders that are open for bidding now, for example in an activity or a region, or closing within a number of days. Takes optional activity, region and closing-within-days filters and no keyword. Returns up to 20 tenders, closing soonest first, with page urls. المنافسات ا

tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this when you have a subject, an entity name, a company name or a month and need the matching records on منصة المناقصات (Saudi government tenders from Etimad, agencies, companies, monthly reports). Returns up to 20 results {id, title, url}, each id in the form tender:<reference_no>, agency:<id>,

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Use this when you have one id and need its full record. Takes tender:<reference_no>, agency:<id>, company:<id> or report:<YYYY-MM> and returns {id, title, text, url, metadata}. السجلّ الكامل لمعرّفٍ واحد مع رابط صفحته.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
